prompt: Show a user logging in through a web app, API, and identity service with success returned to the user.
enzo:
sequence LoginBasic
actor User
participant WebApp
participant Api
participant Identity

sequenceDiagram
actor User
participant WebApp
participant Api
participant Identity

WebApp->>Api: POST /login
Api->>Identity: Validate credentials
Identity-->>Api: Credentials valid
Api-->>WebApp: Session token
WebApp-->>User: Show dashboard
